title: Finnish collocations (Suomen kielen kollokaatiot)
description: Lemma-level collocation dataset for Finnish: 1.54M lemma pairs with logDice, co-occurrence frequency and dispersion; 241k attested example sentences. Built from ~3,700 public-domain Projekti Lönnrot books and Finnish Wikipedia, lemmatized with Voikko. Collocation and lemma files are CC BY 4.0; example sentences are CC BY-SA 4.0 (contain Wikipedia text). Extracted by Asiasanasto.fi.
